environment.description: Same Spring Boot service deployed on EKS 1.28 in namespace 'api-services-prod'. Calico CNI with GlobalNetworkPolicy 'deny-cloud-metadata' applied at tier 'platform' (order 100) with selector 'projectcalico.org/namespace == api-services-prod'. Policy spec: egress deny to CIDRs [169.254.169.254/32, fd00:ec2::254/128] on all ports, applied before namespace-scoped policies. Additionally, a namespace-scoped NetworkPolicy 'restrict-egress-graphql-proxy' with podSelector matchLabels app=graphql-proxy allows egress only to pods matching label 'role=graphql-backend' on port 8080 and to kube-dns on port 53. The deny-all-else implicit rule from the egress policy type blocks remaining traffic. Node IMDS configured with hop-limit=1 (IMDSv2 with token requirement), though the NetworkPolicy blocks connectivity regardless.
